review_scope.layout: Input | alpha=.75 Corrected FLUX | Ground Truth

findings.overall: All 16 fixed corrected outputs are coherent, artifact-free, and visibly closer to GT than the blurred input. The blend preserves more input structure than raw FLUX while retaining substantial deblurring.
findings.motion_and_text: Bus, scooter, signage, tree, fence, and product-text examples show credible restoration without gross hallucination. Some lettering and fine edges remain softer or not exactly identical to GT, as expected for a fixed scalar blend.
findings.tail_metric_interpretation: The worst delta record is not in the fixed visual set. Its candidate remains objectively high quality at 31.479966 dB / .016354 LPIPS; the 12.569169 dB regression is caused by an exceptionally accurate 44.049135 dB base output rather than a low-quality candidate. The predeclared >2 dB regression rule nevertheless fails and cannot be changed post hoc.

decision: Average SOW PSNR/LPIPS and the fixed visual review pass, but the predeclared conservative tail gate fails. Stop under governance hold; do not tune alpha or claim the complete scientific gate passed.
